mononekonameplate
Hello, hello, helllooo Prisoners~ Settling in nicely? Enjoy your cells?
If you find black mould anywhere, no you don’t! Not our problem! What are
you gonna do, report us to the police?
Anyway, someone dropped a FAT donation recently- really excited to see
us kick this off! Good to see so many people are pumped to see proper justice!
Or just uh- see rich people suffer, you do you. I’m not gonna judge!
But as people have been so donation happy, we thought we really must
reward our lovely audience… And that means exposing our Prisoners!
And so… By Popular request-
Crimerevealsign
It’s time for the first edition of- ‘Of course they did it, they’re an Ultimate!’
...Let’s take a good ol’ look at the polls here… It seems you want to
see Prisoner 11 and Prisoner 08… That we can certainly do!
But to start us off, I thought we’d thank the wonderful staff for making this
all possible by putting in their most popular suggestion!
So to kick this off, we’ve got Prisoner 07- Taka Takahiro!
You might be thinking, is he even smart enough to commit some sort of crime?
The only crime I’m seeing here are his shitty outdated one-liners!
Let me tell you, he’s done way worse than drop some skibidi- Ohio- bullshit
unironically!
Takacrimecg
mononekonameplate
What they don’t tell you about celebrities is usually they’ve got a whoooleee
team behind them, a massive crew, a big massive production family!
But in Taka’s case it was more of a… Dysfunctional, abusive family.
Taka really managed to hit every workplace violation and human rights violation
humanly possible, it’s almost impressive.
You could call his show literally not-safe-for-work considering the sheer
number of OSHA violations!
He subjected his crew to long work hours, under-minimum wage pay, no breaks,
no food, limited hygiene products, restricted access to medication on long projects-
and that’s all the stuff you can blame on him being negligent!
Dunno 'bout the verbal abuse of staff, constantly treating them like shit and
expecting them to cater and bend to his every want and need just because he was
a ‘Star’.
Everyone agrees they’d rather work for the devil than Taka Takahiro, ‘cuz at
least you expect to get heat stroke in hellfire-
Oh yeah, Taka’s staff frequently got heat stroke due to the long hours, poor
planning and obscene filming conditions on some of his more ambitious productions.
As far as Taka’s concerned, he’s paying them something so nothing matters
aside from getting good content!
Even if he has to stage it… But you didn’t hear me saying it~
I’d say all of this is pretty standard celebrity bullshit, but it’s unique to
be that shit of a boss that your own workers pay to put you in this game. Guess
you *are* finally memorable, Taka! Congrats!
Tldr- grab the ukulele, Takahiro, you’re gonna need it!
Crimerevealsign
monitorcg
mononekonameplate
Moving on from Mr Yeast or whatever-
We’ve got Prisoner 11, our mellow little herbalist Mint! He could never
hurt a fly, could he?
Y’know, I really think it’s so sweet of him to offer you all medical care
in a situation like this.
Buuuuuuuuuuut… Personally I’d be wary about taking it, just between you and
me-
After all, his last patient only just started recovering- coincidentally right
after we kidnapped Mint… Hm. Funny.
mintcrimecg
mononekonameplate
Or maybe it’s not such a coincidence considering Mint had been covertly
poisoning his last patient to intentionally keep him sick-
Letting him slowly wither into a sickly, weak version of his former self-
Always nauseous, constantly having headaches, feeling too ill to get out of
bed or resist treatment…
Too ill to even see or support his wife and children who depended on him.
‘That’s horrible! Why would that Irish freak even do that?’ You might be asking-
Well dear audience, hold your breath… After all, it gets worse.
After all, that poor little patient who Mint was ‘treating’ with a healthy dose
of nightshade-
Was Mint’s own father and the sole financial support for his family.
…Not that I’m sure Mint noticed the absence of a provider, after all-
He was making a pretty penny claiming his father’s health insurance money due
to his ‘constant chronic illness’ and pocketing it.
Didn’t expect that from someone like him, hm~?
I’d be drinking lots of water tonight if I was you, Maiko! Today’s little remedy
could be the first in Mint’s new treatment plan! Mweheheh!

mononekonameplate
‘Well at least it can’t get more fucked up than that!’ You might be thinking…
Naively.
Don’t you worry, we saved the worst until last!
Prisoner 08, Ismene Circe- proving girls can do it too! Touching!
Of course it’s the Nepo baby that is the most fucked up outta this bunch…
What more could you expect?
Let’s just tear the bandage off here, nice and simple… Might help you think
about who to really trust in a killing game-
IsmeneCrimeCg
mononekonameplate
Ismene Circe is a murderer.
\c[6](...What? No- she…)
mononekonameplate
But she could never properly commit, no- she didn’t want to get
just her own hands dirty.
Ismene convinced her freaky classics-cambridge-college-loser friends to pull a
little ‘prank’ on one of their professors none of them liked.
They got the professor drunk and dragged him into the woods, planning to trick
him into thinking he was being sacrificed-
They thought it was fitting, his seminar was on rituals. Kinda fucked up, but what
else can you expect from people who enjoy writing about Oedipus?
All Ismene’s friends thought they were just going to humiliate their drunk professor,
leave him there and let the school board deal with him in the morning.
So you can imagine they were likely a little shocked when Ismene’s ‘retractable’
dagger wasn’t quite as retractable as she’d said.
And they suddenly had a corpse on their hands, one Ismene had claimed to be
an accident… But it clearly wasn’t.
Not wanting to be implicated in a murder, the friends helped hide the body
and the evidence and they never spoke of it again.
Ismene, being an absolute unempathetic freak, thought that would be the end
of it. And she went on with her life, happy as a stuck-up bitch like her can be.
Nevermind how traumatised the rest of her friends were from the events of that
night… Specifically one called ‘Kota’.
Now ‘Kota’ was a sweet, slightly pathetic boy- on track to becoming an
Ultimate actually!
But the guilt of that night and the ensuing lack of transparency or empathy from
Ismene eventually caused him to have a mental breakdown and drop out of university.
His life hasn’t been the same since, he barely has it together anymore and his
once promising future has fizzled out.
But I guess when you have rich parents, an Ultimate title and almost universal
respect in your field you’re able to just say ‘womp womp’ and move on with your
life!
At least that’s what Ismene did! No remorse at all!
Infact, she’s glad she killed her professor. She still, to this day, feels
like he deserved to die.
Maybe the ‘Gods ordained it or whatever’, I dunno what Classics kids think!
Crimerevealsign
monitorcg
mononekonameplate
That concludes our first three reveals, I think this was verryyy informative into
what these Prisoners are actually like.
You can make your own judgments, of course. I’m sure you’ll come to the right
conclusion here.
But before some of you go and start feeling betrayed, thinking ‘they couldn’t have
done that!’ Just remember-
‘Of course they did it, they’re an Ultimate!’
Okay, now go to bed. I’ve got shit to do. If you’ve got any questions, wait until
the morning.
Buh-byee!! Mweheheheh!
